lastMutation.scope: Issue #366 add/sub half (PR #393): LibDecimalFloatImplementation.add and sub near the exponent floor. Before = testAddNearFloorMatchesShifted and testSubNearFloorMatchesShifted at 0d5de9d, which compare the library with itself on operands shifted up by -type(int256).min. After = testAddNearFloorExact and testSubNearFloorExact at 0ee3544, expected parts from LibTestExactDecimal.addPartsWide. Probe suite: forge test restricted to the two tests in each tree. Floor mutants: F1 shed ignores the overflow lift, F2 shed keeps the exponent, F3 swap ignores the shortfall tie-break, F4 early return ignores the shortfall difference, F5 alignment ignores the shortfall difference, F6 shed skipped, F7 shed one digit short, F8 minus of int256.min keeps the exponent. Shared-path mutants: G1 aligned sum one unit up, G2 positive overflow shed rounds away from zero, G3 negative overflow shed offset 3 to 0, G4 positive overflow shed drops the carry, G5 early return boundary > to >=. Survivors before: F8 and G1-G5; none after. The mul/div half (M01-M10) was probed on main 8fcfeb3: 4/10 killed before, 10/10 after.
